content.short: Kittenswap is a ve(3,3) exchange on HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain with veKITTEN emissions voting.
content.description: Kittenswap is a ve(3,3) DEX running on HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain, where veKITTEN lockers steer emissions toward the pools they want deepened. The full ve(3,3) system is live on HyperEVM, while Robinhood Chain currently carries swaps and liquidity provision. Concentrated liquidity positions are supported for providers wanting tighter capital efficiency. A points season rewards users who trade and supply liquidity.
content.meta: veKITTEN lockers direct emissions toward the pools actually producing fees.
